column1: # Five labels corrected 2026-11-20 (icounter, perplexity, instacart, oyorooms, cleartrip) after a hunt applied the STEP 5 evidence standard to them. The original labels were written from search snippets without that standard. The correction was driven by the evidence test, not by how the pipeline ranked them: Mamaearth was kept as buy despite scoring nothing, and Perplexity was flipped to no despite a real need.
